speaker: abel_garnish
text: Seventeen parts, copied in six days. The names are on the dowels. Do not snatch, Master Kemp.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You said Abel reads. I came to hear Abel.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I said Abel, on Saturday, because no roll was in a hand and none was leaving the parlour. This morning I read. Every voice. Sit down.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Read, then. The fire is up. I have kept my hands off Berowne until thou art done.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Hold. You are reading the country fellow like a man who wants him mended. If that is the bait, I am taking it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The roll with your name on it is in the basket. If Costard wants a better mouth, the mouth is yours.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Master Pope. Armado. The third strip was pasted wet. Have a care at the join.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will try his first letter while the prose is warm.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I have lost the third word. I will not invent it in front of you, and you are all useless to me.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Keep the loss, Tom. A letter that dies early has done this table more good than a letter that arrives.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Unroll, Dick. Yours against mine, along the floor. I want the length. I am not calling a winner, and you are not calling one either.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The floor has them. The floor is not a judge. Thou art not writing a judgment into the book, Will.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not writing one, Dick. Pick them up before Abel's paste meets the hearth.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The songs at the end. I have been humming, and humming will not teach a boy the breath. Let me have them by Friday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You shall have a pointing by Friday, Augustine. I am not copying the verses onto a new sheet. They were finished on the twenty-first. The book still has them.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Master Shakespeare. After the news of her father, does the Princess weep?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. She governs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mark it so, Nick. Thou hast the answer, and I will not give thee a second.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: John said last night, the Princess wants a gown. He is not here to say it again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He said it on the call, when the ladies were counted. He is not one of this table. The parts go out without him, and the gown is not bought this morning.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we are done with last night's call. Thou hast read. The Shrew is at two, and I am not carrying this book into Gracechurch Street on top of it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: If a dowel is lost between this door and the Keys, the man who lost it copies the second himself, at his own candle.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I can hunt the third word by two, or I can play the afternoon and hunt it after. I know which one the yard pays.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You read me badly, and I thank you for it. You said Abel. Abel copied. You read. I can hold both without making them the same hour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hold them so. I am in the Shrew. I am not naming the roll. Set at Maw is the Rose, and I am not going.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: By Friday, then. The pointing, and not a cleaner copy. I have heard you.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have marked it. She governs. I will not ask a second time.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Home, if thou art eating, and then the Keys. Do not con Berowne over a loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Little at home, Dick, and then the play. I am not conning it for thee over a loaf, and I am not answering Anne from this room.
